correctness.rationale: For all a,b≥3, Z=C_a*C_b and the two K_{a,b} central-arrow links give an equivariant exact relative-homology computation over the integers. Graph cycle lattices are torsion-free and K_ab H1 is naturally V_a⊗V_b. Balanced hub interchange changes factors in join H3 with sign (+1) and swaps the two degree-two link summands. Direct finite Lefschetz enumeration tested every 72 full-group element at (3,3) and every 144 leaf-group element at (3,4), plus independent mod-two boundary ranks.
